contracts.name: Dataset lineage contract
contracts.rule: Any external dataset import must preserve source, codebook, license, contributor, import date, and original field semantics.

contracts.name: Source voice contract
contracts.rule: Every atom/claim must retain who is speaking and what kind of source supports it.

contracts.name: Claim modality contract
contracts.rule: Alleged, denied, filed, ordered, sustained, exonerated, settled, dismissed, convicted, acquitted, reversed, sealed, and missing are not interchangeable.

contracts.name: Identity merge contract
contracts.rule: No imported row can merge a person or agency without explicit evidence-weighted receipt and unmerge route.

contracts.name: Privacy minimization contract
contracts.rule: Imported rows must be minimizable before public display; raw payload availability is not display permission.

contracts.name: Correction propagation contract
contracts.rule: Corrections, source updates, reversals, and contestations must propagate to every dependent public surface.

contracts.name: Licensing and attribution contract
contracts.rule: Civic, academic, journalism, and partner datasets keep attribution and reuse constraints.

contracts.name: Missingness contract
contracts.rule: Absent rows in an external dataset cannot be transformed into absence of misconduct, discipline, liability, or reform.

contracts.name: Denominator contract
contracts.rule: No rates or comparisons without matching denominator, time, jurisdiction, and unit-of-analysis proof.

contracts.name: Payload custody contract
contracts.rule: Payloads are not summarized before preservation, fixity, privacy, and extraction gates.

contracts.name: Role-access contract
contracts.rule: High-harm surfaces such as Brady/Giglio, family packets, and witness data may require role-gated or non-public access.

contracts.name: Contribution-back contract
contracts.rule: The cube should not only ingest from civic actors; it should provide reusable source packets and correction routes back to them.
